anki.label: Anki
anki.step1: In the Anki desktop app, choose File → Export.
anki.step2: Pick “Anki Deck Package (.apkg)” for one deck, or “Anki Collection Package (.colpkg)” for your whole profile.
anki.step3: Keep “Include media” checked so images and audio come across.
anki.step4: Upload the exported file or files below. You can add several at once.

quizlet.label: Quizlet
quizlet.step1: Open your set on Quizlet and click ⋯ (More) → Export.
quizlet.step2: Leave “Between term and definition” as Tab and “Between cards” as New line.

csv.label: CSV / TSV
csv.step1: Export or save your cards as CSV or TSV.
csv.step2: Put the front in the first column and the back in the second (an optional hint in the third).

json.label: OpenDeck JSON
json.step1: Upload a .json file you exported from OpenDeck.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: OpenDeck is an open flashcard application built on the AT Protocol. It reads from and writes to your Personal Data Server. OpenDeck does not operate its own account system and does not store your flashcards, study progress, or profile on its own servers.
terms.s2Body: You sign in with an existing ATproto identity. All content you create, including decks, cards, study progress, likes and follows, is stored as records in your own repository under the space.opendeck lexicons. You may delete or export this data at any time using any ATproto compatible tool. You can view your raw records on {link}.
terms.s3Body: Most data on ATproto is public by default. Unless a record is stored in a permissioned Space, assume anything you publish can be read by others. OpenDeck lets you choose what appears on your profile, but this is a display preference and not a confidentiality guarantee.
terms.s4Body: Do not use OpenDeck to publish unlawful content or to infringe the rights of others. Because content lives in your repository, you are responsible for it.
terms.s5Body: OpenDeck is provided as is without warranty of any kind. Spaced repetition scheduling is a study aid and not a guarantee of results.
terms.s6Body: These terms may change as the project evolves. Continued use means you accept the current version.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: OpenDeck stores everything in your own ATproto repository. We do not run a database of your flashcards or progress and we do not sell or share your data since we never hold it. You can explore your public records on {link}.
privacy.s2Body: Sign in uses ATproto OAuth. Tokens are handled entirely in your browser and stored locally. OpenDeck never sees your password because you authenticate directly with your Personal Data Server.
privacy.s3Body: To show your name and avatar, OpenDeck reads your public Bluesky profile. Account search uses the public AppView network. These are public ATproto endpoints.
privacy.s4Body: For offline support and speed, OpenDeck caches decks, cards and progress in your browser. It also remembers small preferences like your theme in local storage. This data stays on your device and can be cleared at any time.
privacy.s5Body: Study reminders are scheduled locally by your browser and only fire if you grant notification permission. No push server is involved and no reminder data leaves your device.
privacy.s6Body: OpenDeck ships without third party tracking or advertising.
